verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a REST API for syncs, models, sources, and destinations, plus Git Sync for managing workspace resources programmatically, and lets you configure syncs via API instead of the app. An official MCP server extends programmatic reach to audiences, journeys, and ad creatives. However, the REST API's documented scope covers only core Reverse ETL resources, while audiences and journeys are presented mainly as no-code UI work, and nothing claims full UI parity. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of audiences, journeys, AI Decisioning, identity resolution and permissions; an explicit UI/API parity statement; a public OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404); independent corroboration.
